title: NQCC Signs Enterprise Agreement with Phasecraft to Provide Quantum Software via SparQ Access - Quantum Computing Report
gist: The UK NQCC signed an enterprise licensing agreement with Phasecraft to offer its Magritte (simulation), Monet (quantum-enhanced DFT chemistry) and Mondrian (hybrid optimization) software via SparQ Access, the first commercial quantum software added to the program. An open call opens late November 2026 with the first cohort starting Spring 2027.

themes.theme: Public program moves up the stack

insights.claim: The NQCC's enterprise agreement with Phasecraft is the first time it has integrated dedicated commercial quantum software into SparQ Access, which previously focused on brokering hardware runtime.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Signals the state recognizing the application software layer, not just hardware, as the bottleneck to adoption.
insights.locator: The UK’s National Quantum Computing Centre

insights.claim: By pairing application software with compute access, the NQCC aims to move UK industry users from exploratory hardware benchmarking toward domain-specific workload preparation ahead of early fault-tolerant deployments.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Positions algorithm/software vendors to capture value early by preparing customers for fault-tolerant machines before they arrive.
insights.quote: transition UK industry users from exploratory hardware benchmarking toward domain-specific workload preparation ahead of early fault-tolerant quantum deployments

insights.claim: The partnership aims to lower the technical barrier for domain specialists in condensed matter physics, chemical modeling and industrial combinatorial optimization to evaluate practical quantum advantage.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Lower onboarding friction expands the potential buyer base beyond quantum specialists.
insights.locator: The UK’s National Quantum Computing Centre

insights.claim: Phasecraft's Magritte is a quantum simulation platform for materials science and molecular modeling focused on hardware-aware circuit construction and algorithmic resource estimation.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Resource estimation tools are how enterprises judge when quantum hardware becomes useful for them.

insights.claim: Phasecraft's Monet uses quantum-enhanced density functional theory to simulate strongly correlated electronic structures and complex molecular systems.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Strongly correlated chemistry is a leading candidate domain for early quantum advantage, relevant to materials and pharma.

insights.claim: Phasecraft's Mondrian is an API- and web-accessible optimization engine for classical-quantum hybrid solvers in logistics routing, grid infrastructure and quantitative finance.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hybrid solvers deliverable via API are the nearest-term commercial route, targeting finance and logistics buyers.

insights.claim: The NQCC and Phasecraft will open a call for proposals in late November 2026, with the first user cohort starting in Spring 2027 and receiving onboarding and co-development support from Phasecraft scientists.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Sets dates for when Phasecraft gains a state-subsidized pipeline of UK enterprise users.
insights.quote: issue an open call for proposals in late November 2026, with the inaugural user cohort commencing in Spring 2027
insights.locator: Under the terms of the agreement
